cohort: The study included 25 pregnant women diagnosed with oligohydramnios (AFI < 5 cm) after 37 completed weeks of gestation, compared with 25 matched controls without oligohydramnios.
finding: The study found an increased incidence of labor induction and low birth weight in pregnant women with oligohydramnios compared to controls.
mod_finding: The study identified an increased rate of labor induction in women with oligohydramnios and aimed to evaluate AFI's role in predicting caesarean delivery.
gest_age: At or after 37 completed weeks of gestation
